decisions.reason: The limitation to three colour versions concerns the full-color, black, and white treatments, not the independently confirmed with-box and without-box background variants.
Narrowing the delivered colour versions does not change source-file editability, required file formats, or intended uses.
The decision limits the number of delivered colour variants but does not alter the selected rev4-02 artwork or its primary graduated-orange and black color treatment.
The source decision concerns final-delivery colour variants and does not change the already delivered initial concept set.
The client reiterates that brand colors and font information are what they meant by guidelines, but does not change the existing requirement to supply the brand color specification.
The number of delivered colour versions has no effect on the required business name, excluded term, or strapline.
Limiting final colour variants does not modify the requirement that the logo artwork be fresh and original.
